summary: Frontend-only iteration verifying (1) gallery first-image ratio/crop bug fix, (2) new logo across header/footer/home-intro, (3) redesigned white intro splash with larger logo, (4) new clickable gallery thumbnail strip. All primary items VERIFIED PASSING on /project/folded-wallshelf and /. Two minor observations flagged.

issues: Logo width on wide desktop (1920px) is 672px = ~35% viewport width because max-w-2xl (42rem) caps it; the review request expected ~60-75%. On mobile/tablet the 72vw rule dominates and logo is large as intended. If the intent was truly 60-75% on desktop too, consider max-w-4xl or removing the desktop cap. Not a functional bug — clearly larger than the header logo, no plate box, white bg all correct.

document.body.scrollWidth = 435 vs clientWidth = 390 -> ~45px horizontal overflow on /project/folded-wallshelf at 390px. Source not reachable via non-clipped tree walk (all suspect elements are inside embla overflow-hidden or thumbnails overflow-x-auto), so it may be a pre-existing minor overflow (also flagged historically). Not visually catastrophic — page renders fine — but the review request explicitly asked to confirm no horizontal overflow on mobile project pages, so flagging.

Bounding box measured 768x576 (ratio 1.333 = landscape 4:3) matching img.ratio='landscape' + crop=true stored in DB. Slide 2 and others also have aspect classes applied. Bug is fixed.

verification_details.gallery_thumbnails: PASS — 6 thumbnails with data-testid=gallery-thumb-0..5 rendered. Click on gallery-thumb-2 scrolled main gallery to slide index 2, counter updated to 03/06, active thumb picked up border-ink class. Arrow navigation also updates active thumb (verified next/prev updates counter and highlight moves).
verification_details.home_intro_bg_white: PASS — computed background-color = rgb(255,255,255). No dark bg, no plate/card wrapper around logo.
verification_details.home_intro_logo_url: PASS — src contains 'LOGO%20TERBARU-01'. Larger than header logo (672px vs ~28px).

verification_details.footer_logo: PASS — [data-testid=footer-wordmark] src contains 'LOGO%20TERBARU-01', not the old file.

action_items: (Optional) Address ~45px horizontal overflow on mobile /project/* pages if it wasn't a pre-existing issue — inspect what's contributing to body.scrollWidth beyond viewport.
(Optional) If desktop intro logo should be 60-75% of viewport as originally described, raise the max-width cap on md+ (currently max-w-2xl / 42rem) — otherwise leave as designed.

HomeIntro.jsx: LOGO_URL hard-coded — acceptable but could live in a shared constant with SiteHeader/SiteFooter (currently duplicated in 3 files). Minor DRY improvement.
SiteHeader/SiteFooter/HomeIntro all inline the same logo URL — extract to /lib/assets.js to avoid future drift.
